tool_input_args.value:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert a DOCX file to PDF using LibreOffice and email it as an attachment.

Prerequisites:
  - LibreOffice installed and available on PATH
      macOS:   brew install --cask libreoffice
      Ubuntu:  sudo apt install libreoffice
      Windows: https://www.libreoffice.org/download/
  - Python 3.6+

Usage:
  python3 scripts/convert_and_email.py

Before running, update the SMTP_* constants below with your mail server details.
"""

import os
import smtplib
import subprocess
import sys
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration – update these before running
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"  # Input DOCX file
PDF_OUTPUT_DIR = "docs"                   # Where to save the PDF

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"            # Your SMTP server
SMTP_PORT = 587                           # 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL
SMTP_USER = "you@example.com"             # Your login / sender address
SMTP_PASSWORD = ""                        # App password or SMTP password (set via env var below)

SENDER = SMTP_USER
RECIPIENT = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT = "Customer Report (PDF)"
BODY = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, output_dir: str) -> Path:
    """Convert a DOCX file to PDF using LibreOffice in headless mode."""
    docx = Path(docx_path)
    if not docx.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: Input file not found: {docx}")

    out = Path(output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Converting {docx} to PDF …")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "libreoffice",
            "--headless",
            "--convert-to", "pdf",
            "--outdir", str(out),
            str(docx),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(
            f"LibreOffice conversion failed (exit {result.returncode}):\n"
            f"{result.stderr or result.stdout}"
        )

    pdf_path = out / docx.with_suffix(".pdf").name
    if not pdf_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: Expected PDF not found at {pdf_path}")

    print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}")
    return pdf_path


def send_email(pdf_path: Path) -> None:
    """Send an email with the PDF attached via SMTP."""
    password = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", SMTP_PASSWORD)
    if not password:
        sys.exit(
            "Error: No SMTP password set. Either edit SMTP_PASSWORD in the script "
            "or export SMTP_PASSWORD in your environment."
        )

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.set_content(BODY)

    # Attach the PDF
    pdf_data = pdf_path.read_bytes()
    msg.add_attachment(
        pdf_data,
        maintype="application",
        subtype="pdf",
        filename=pdf_path.name,
    )

    print(f"Sending email to {RECIPIENT} via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} …")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, password)
        server.send_message(msg)

    print("Email sent successfully!")


def main() -> None:
    pdf_path = convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_OUTPUT_DIR)
    send_email(pdf_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
